Blackthorn University’s Alumni Reunion Weekend ### Users **User Type 1:** Alumni ({{variable.Object_Attendee}}s) * A Blackthorn University graduate will travel back to campus. * They want to connect with others from their class and enjoy a sense of nostalgia. * They use the {{variable.Product_BlackthoEventNavigator}} app. **User Type 2:** Event Organizer (Salesforce User) * This individual is an employee of Blackthorn University who plans reunion events and other alum gatherings throughout the year. * They create or configure the Salesforce {{variable.Object_Event}} record for the reunion. * They use the {{variable.Product_MobileCheck-inApp}} to check in {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s. ### Event Objectives * Maintain a strong alumni network. * Maintain relationships between the university and the alumni, which results in more fundraising. * Create connections to help build relationships that result in donations in the future. ### About the Attendees * Usually, 10-50% of any specific class year will attend. * A single reunion may include the classes of ‘80, ‘85, ‘90, ‘95, etc. * Most reunions have between 1,000 and 3,000 attendees, who can be split into different graduation years. ### The Event The Event Organizer(s) plans the {{variable.Object_Event}} and invites {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s using {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} and the {{variable.Product_Events}} app. At the {{variable.Object_Event}}, Event Organizers use the {{variable.Product_MobileCheck-inApp}} to check in {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s for the {{variable.Object_Event}} and Sessions. {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s use the Navigator app to keep track of their schedule, sign up or cancel registrations for free {{variable.Object_Session}}s, check in for {{variable.Object_Session}}s, see who else is attending the {{variable.Object_Event}}, receive essential notifications, and review important information the Event Organizers want to share (maps and other documentation). After the {{variable.Object_Event}}, organizers can use data from the Navigator app and Salesforce to plan future events, examine ROI, and guide relationship-building for future donations.
